mentions.name: Meeting Notes
mentions.description: A local meeting transcription app, a Granola clone built before Granola existed, that used Whisper for transcription.
mentions.problem: Seamless local audio capture was janky and unreliable because unsigned apps lack access to much better system audio resources.
mentions.source_excerpt: Project: Meeting Notes - Before Granola existed, this was a local granola clone that used whisper. Only later did I find that the real gap in making this work seamlessly without the janky MIDI Audio Capture was that if it was a "signed" app it got access to much better resources.
